note: How a saved Recipe written on install A is reused on an independent install B. Path handling belongs to P06, source binding to P04, and acceptance to S4-04-G. Nothing in this file is a PASS.
profile: supportProfile in cli-acceptance-contract.json; independent clean installs A and B, not just a different CWD on one host

artifacts.condition: script and DockerfileContent are stored in the file; a DockerfilePath authoring input is frozen into Content, and the original A file is not required

artifacts.artifact: ToolFunctionRecipe JSON plus relative companion files
artifacts.condition: ScriptPath and FixtureReference.LocalPath are host references relative to the Recipe directory; companions travel in the same relative layout
exact authoring/companion bytes and the actual Resolve result; past snapshots are never rewritten; current edits show as divergence
endpoint, install path, credentials and A's journal are not transfer inputs; importing a Recipe never resumes or replays A's remote work

rules.relativeBase: directory that contains the Recipe file
rules.absoluteHostPath: rejected with exit 2 and RPC 0; no automatic rewrite and no fallback to A
rules.imageInternalPaths: kept verbatim; never resolved as host paths
rules.digestOnlyFixture: ContentDigest declaration and meaning are kept; no local file is created, uploaded or dry-run
rules.declaredLocalPathFixture: placement and absence are checked; data acceptance and execution success are not claimed

key: logical path relative to the Recipe
sourceBinding.digestOnly: bound to the original declaration; file bytes are never guessed
sourceBinding.notGlobalIdentity: a local binding hash, not a ToolSpec digest or a global Manifest/Lock format

variants.input: Recipe and companions copied to B in the same relative layout; B runs from another CWD
variants.expected: validate/render read B's companions; A is not accessed

variants.input: ScriptPath is an absolute path from A
FixtureReference with ContentDigest and no LocalPath
Command.Executable and WorkingDirectory are image paths that do not exist on B
variants.expected: kept verbatim; not checked against B's filesystem

decisionBoundary: Decision 44-46: mutable Authoring Manifest and immutable Resolved Lock with exact source linkage may be packaged together. The existing Recipe JSON is the CLI storage adapter; the global bundle/hash format stays OPEN.
